title: 第25章 练血一层
content_zh:
突破到练气二层之后，感受更丰裕的灵息运转，就连浑身筋肉身躯也因此提升受益。

    更令韩榆惊讶的是，他原以为自己九滴精血就到了炼血功修炼的极限，没想到自己突破练气二层之后，身躯内容纳精血的极限也变高，不仅是原来九滴精血变成了十滴精血，甚至还能再继续提升。

    而右手处的复制能力随着韩榆的修为提升，也果然悄然又有所增加。

    本来可以一天复制一滴精血，现在也能够复制两滴精血。

    这样一来，血滴子可以一口气释放十二次之多，如此攻击能力，想来已经超过了寻常练气前三层的杂役弟子们。

    复制玄心果则是还做不到一天复制两颗，非要算的话，大概是三天时间可以复制四颗玄心果。

    韩榆感应着这种变化，心中微微振奋。

    练气二层了，按照《青禾练气心法》，接下来丹田内灵种完全冒出萌芽，便是练气三层；等到灵种萌芽舒展出第一个叶片，便是练气四层，到时候就有资格成为万春谷的外门弟子。

    也是时候，再去青禾坊市找一找炼体功法或其他有用之物，来进一步提升自身了。

    “嘎！”

    随着一大一小两声叫唤，越发灵动神气的大乌鸦、小乌鸦两个从夜色中穿梭而来，落在韩榆面前。

    今日又没找到灵果，这倒也是正常的情况。

    毕竟万春谷附近修士太多，很少有不识货的，但凡灵果灵草有一点迹象，都很容易被发现，之前找到玄心果、灵血藤两种灵物就已经颇为不容易。

    “嘎！”

    大乌鸦对韩榆轻唤一声，歪头看向窗户方向。

    韩榆疑惑：“你是说，外面有情况？”

    悄然走到窗口，见到月色下一道婀娜身姿朝着王管事房屋方向走去，顿时失笑：这不是那位韦师姐吗？

    她跟王管事的事情，韩榆早在一两月前就已经知道，本来也无需关注，这有什么可看的？

    不过，紧接着韩榆便注意到，真正需要注意的并不是韦师姐，而是韦师姐走过之后，一个蹲着身体悄悄挪动的身影。

    那身影蹲在韩榆和李老道两处灵田的交界处，不知道干了什么，随后又缓缓挪动身体，走出一段距离后才匆匆离去。

    韩榆一开始也没看清楚这人是谁，等他走得远了，站起身来，便认出来了。

    这是张山。
content_en:
After breaking through to the second level of Qi training, you can feel the more abundant spiritual energy flowing, and even your muscles and muscles will benefit from it.

    What surprised Han Yu even more was that he originally thought that nine drops of blood essence would reach the limit of his blood refining skills. Unexpectedly, after he broke through the second level of Qi training, the limit of blood essence contained in his body would also become higher. Not only would the original nine drops of blood essence become ten drops of blood essence, but it would even continue to increase.

    As Han Yu's cultivation improved, the copying ability on his right hand also quietly increased.

    Originally, I could copy one drop of blood essence a day, but now I can copy two drops of blood essence.

    In this way, the blood drops can be released as many as twelve times in one breath. Such attack power must have surpassed the handyman disciples in the first three levels of ordinary Qi training.

    When it comes to copying the Mysterious Heart Fruit, it is not possible to copy two Mysterious Heart Fruits in one day. If you have to count, it would take about three days to copy four Mysterious Heart Fruits.

    Sensing this change, Han Yu felt slightly excited.

    It is the second level of Qi training. According to the "Qinghe Qi Training Heart Method", after the spiritual seeds in the Dantian are completely sprouted, it will be the third level of Qi training; when the spiritual seeds sprout and stretch out the first leaves, it will be the fourth level of Qi training. At that time, you will be qualified to become an outer disciple of Wanchun Valley.

    It's time to go to Qinghefang City to find some body-building exercises or other useful things to further improve yourself.

    "Gah!"

    Following two cries, one large and one small, two crows, a big crow and a small crow, which became more and more agile and energetic, shuttled through the night and landed in front of Han Yu.

    No spiritual fruit was found today, which is normal.

    After all, there are too many monks around Wanchun Valley, and there are very few who are ignorant. As long as there are any signs of spiritual fruits and spiritual grasses, they can be easily discovered. It was already quite difficult to find two spiritual objects, Xuanxin Fruit and Spiritual Blood Vine.

    "Gah!"

    The big crow called Han Yu softly and tilted his head to look toward the window.

    Han Yu was confused: "You mean, there is something going on outside?"

    I quietly walked to the window and saw a graceful figure walking towards Manager Wang's house under the moonlight. I suddenly laughed: Isn't this Senior Sister Wei?

    Han Yu had known about her affair with Guanshi Wang a month or two ago, and there was no need to pay attention to it. What was there to see?

    However, Han Yu immediately noticed that what really needed attention was not Senior Sister Wei, but a crouching figure that moved quietly after Senior Sister Wei passed by.

    The figure squatted at the junction of the two spiritual fields of Han Yu and Li Laodao. He didn't know what he was doing. Then he slowly moved his body and walked a certain distance before leaving in a hurry.

    Han Yu didn't see clearly who this person was at first, but when he walked far away and stood up, he recognized him.

    This is Zhang Shan.
